mapper.select: select case when e.score * 100.0 / ifnull(p.total_score, 100) >= 90 then '优' when e.score * 100.0 / ifnull(p.total_score, 100) >= 80 then '良' when e.score * 100.0 / ifnull(p.total_score, 100) >= 60 then '中' else '差' end as grade, count(1) as cnt from jc_edu_exam e left join jc_edu_paper p on p.paper_id = e.paper_id where e.del_flag = '0' and e.status = '1' group by grade order by cnt desc
select q.qtype as qtype, count(1) as cnt from jc_edu_question q where q.del_flag = '0' group by q.qtype order by cnt desc
select q.category as category, count(1) as cnt from jc_edu_question q where q.del_flag = '0' group by q.category order by cnt desc

select date_format(e.submit_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(1) as cnt from jc_edu_exam e where e.del_flag = '0' and e.status = '1' and e.submit_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month) group by month order by month

select a.question_id as questionId, min(pq.title_snapshot) as title, count(1) as wrongCnt from jc_edu_exam_answer a left join jc_edu_paper_question pq on pq.question_id = a.question_id and pq.paper_id = (select paper_id from jc_edu_exam where exam_id = a.exam_id) where a.correct = '0' group by a.question_id order by wrongCnt desc limit #{limit}

select c.commit_id as commitId, c.title as title, c.scope_type as scopeType, (select count(1) from jc_edu_commitment s where s.parent_id = c.commit_id and s.record_type = '1' and s.status = '1' and s.del_flag = '0') as signedCnt from jc_edu_commitment c where c.record_type = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.create_time desc
select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{key}

select e.person_id as personId, max(e.person_name) as personName, count(1) as examCnt, max(e.score) as bestScore, sum(case when e.passed = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as passCnt from jc_edu_exam e where e.del_flag = '0' and e.status = '1' group by e.person_id order by bestScore desc, passCnt desc limit #{limit}
